title: Report of compliance.
officialText:
The owner of a building required to comply with the provisions of Section G311.2 shall file
with the department, by January 1, 2033, a report prepared by a registered design professional or licensed master electrician
(i) certifying that the requirements of Section G311.2 have been satisfied and detailing how such requirements were satisfied
or (ii) certifying that the building met or was altered to meet the provisions of any applicable exception in Sections G304.5.1
or G304.5.2.
